purpose: Define the future passive readmodel output for News Intelligence expansion so panel/review consumers can see context without receiving trade, veto, classification or final decision authority.
core_rule: The readmodel is display/review context only. It must preserve uncertainty and missing evidence instead of presenting news as a final signal.

null_and_unknown_policy.unknown_identity: Use UNRESOLVED and missing_evidence; do not fabricate token identity.
null_and_unknown_policy.not_token_specific: Use NOT_TOKEN_SPECIFIC and keep token fields null.
null_and_unknown_policy.unknown_context: Use UNKNOWN_CONTEXT and explain missing evidence.
null_and_unknown_policy.incomplete_evidence: Use missing_evidence list before downstream use.

consumer_rules.panel: May display passive context, review priority and missing evidence.
consumer_rules.review_queue: May prioritize human/system review but cannot decide outcome.
consumer_rules.prosecutor_context: May use as hypothesis input only.
consumer_rules.opportunity_memory: May use as case-memory candidate only.

future_validation_rules: Reject readmodel item if forbidden field appears.
Reject token-specific readmodel item when identity_status is UNRESOLVED and token_address is missing.
Reject high review priority if evidence_state is SINGLE_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED and no risk family is present.
Reject final-decision wording in display text.
Require missing_evidence when evidence_state is not CONFIRMED_CONTEXT_NOT_DECISION.
